chapter: String bands, serenading and violin players
title: Starting on mandolin and guitar, serenading, banjo with Hippolyte Charles
summary: Dawson says he began with serenading on mandolin, guitar and bass, and only took up banjo after joining Hippolyte Charles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. That's what I started with. When you guitar, huh? Yeah, going out at night parties on Saturday night, weekend, good timing. I used to play mandolin, too, you know. Yeah, I know. Started on the mandolin. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
Banjo, no, I wasn't playing no banjo then. I only took up banjo after I started with Hippolyte Charles.
